component.name: HikLens
component.summary: Monitor and play back Hikvision DVR and NVR cameras on Linux and Steam Deck

description.p: HikLens lets you monitor Hikvision DVR and NVR security cameras from a Linux desktop or Steam Deck. View HTTP snapshots, embedded RTSP streams, or (with a separately installed official Linux SDK) an encrypted-stream and DVR recordings playback backend. Switch between a camera grid and single-camera view, scrub recorded video on an interactive timeline, and save snapshots or MP4 recordings.
The application can also display real-time ISAPI motion events from the DVR, open a stream in ffplay for high-quality playback, and navigate with Steam Deck gamepad controls.
The optional Hikvision SDK is proprietary and is not included. HikLens is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
